title: Logo versions and misuse
slide_intent: Teach designers which adaptations preserve recognition as backgrounds and production methods change. Paired families of examples help readers distinguish permissible contrast changes from changes to the mark’s structure.
strategic_value: Halfkey can accommodate covers, screens, stamps and engraving while keeping the solid half and the counted dot field recognizable.
demonstration: The upper row shows six approved color treatments of the stacked lockup. The lower row isolates six structural or color changes and labels each misuse.
practical_value: A designer can choose an approved version for a given background or one-color process and check a proposed asset against the misuse row.

content_islands.name: Running header
content_islands.spec: Place the book identifiers at upper left and Logo versions and misuse with page 06 at upper right.

content_islands.name: Approved versions
content_islands.spec: Align six equal cards under Versions on colour. Show primary, reversed, signal blue, screen tint, one-color and reversed one-color treatments. Keep the same stacked arrangement and label the background or production use below each card.

content_islands.name: Misuse examples
content_islands.spec: Repeat the six-column grid under Misuse. Show filled dots, swapped halves, recoloring, distortion, rotation and a redrawn dot field. Add a cross and a short caption under each example.
